k:援.mnemonic: A friend (友) hangs from the cliff edge by one hand hooked like a claw (爪), and your fingers (扌) reach down to pull him up. Abet (help, save).

k:盟.mnemonic: Under a bright (明) sky two chiefs drink in turn from one dish (皿) and swear to stand together from now on. Alliance (oath).

k:捜.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) rummage through every drawer, and also (又) a second hand sweeps under the bed, while the owner mutters 'wherefore (由) has it gone?' Search (look for, locate).
k:捜.hint: Rummaging drawers and under the bed.

k:農.mnemonic: Farmers bend (曲) over the field from dawn, turning the earth with hoes made from clam (辰) shells, as the first growers did. Agriculture (farmers).

k:温.mnemonic: Water left by the tsunami (氵) is caught in a dish (皿) and stands out in the day (日) sun. By afternoon it is pleasant to dip a hand in. Warm.
k:温.hint: Dish of water in the sun.

k:測.mnemonic: After the tsunami (氵) someone lowers a rule (則), a long measuring stick, into the flood to find how deep the water stands. Fathom (plan, scheme, measure).

k:覧.mnemonic: A retainer (臣) is told to see (見) every line of the scroll before his lord signs it, so he looks it over slowly from end to end. Perusal (look, watch, view).

k:余.mnemonic: Right now (今) the banquet table is on show (示), and it holds far more food than the guests could ever eat. There will be leftovers for a week. Too much (surplus, remainder, myself).
k:余.hint: Banquet with a week of leftovers.

k:短.mnemonic: What do you know (知) about beans (豆)? Mostly that each one is tiny, no longer than a fingernail from end to end. Short (brevity, fault, defect).

k:軽.mnemonic: A car (車) that rolls over soft soil (土) without leaving a rut, and that you can also (又) push along with one hand. It weighs almost nothing. Lightly (trifling, unimportant).
k:軽.hint: A car pushed with one hand.

k:輪.mnemonic: The car (車) is propped up on a fat tome (冊), because right now (今) the round thing it rolls on is off for repair. Wheel (ring, circle, loop).
k:輪.hint: Car propped on a thick book.

k:染.mnemonic: Bark from a tree (木) is boiled in a tsunami (氵) of water, and the cloth is dipped nine (九) times until the colour holds fast. Dye (color, paint, stain).

k:訴.mnemonic: 'He did it,' the villagers say (言), pointing at the man who stands beside the fallen shrine tree with the axe (斤) still in his hand. Accusation (sue, appeal to).
k:訴.hint: Pointing at the man with the axe.

k:販.mnemonic: The shoppers are anti- (反) spending their shellfish (貝) coins, so the seller paints signs and shouts special offers to change their minds. Marketing (sell, trade, sale).
k:販.hint: Signs and shouts to loosen purses.

k:為.mnemonic: Grab the handle (ユ) of the cradle (勹) and carry it clear of the flames (灬). There is no time to think about it, only to act. Do (change, make, benefit).
k:為.hint: Snatching the cradle from the fire.

k:臼.mnemonic: A deep stone bowl seen from the side, with a notch in the rim and a ridge inside where the grain is pounded. Mortar.

k:興.mnemonic: The same (同) show at every festival: the villagers pound rice in a giant mortar (臼) to a drumbeat while the crowd claps along. Entertain (revive, interest, pleasure).

k:訳.mnemonic: A man standing beside a foreign flag (尸) repeats whatever the visitors say (言), but in your own language. Translate (reason, circumstance, logic).
k:訳.hint: The man beside the foreign flag.

k:諸.mnemonic: Ask what happened and each someone (者) will say (言) a different thing: there are many accounts, of every kind. Various (many, several, together).

k:茂.mnemonic: Leave the flowers (艹) alone for one summer and see what they become (成): a tangle over the path and halfway up the walls. Overgrown (grow thick, be luxuriant).
k:茂.hint: A garden left for a summer.

k:蔵.mnemonic: Under an overhang (厂), hidden by overgrown (茂) vines, a retainer (臣) guards the door behind which the lord keeps his rice and gold. Storehouse (hide, own, possess).

k:識.mnemonic: The sentry cannot see in the dark, but from the sound (音) of what people say (言) he tells friend from enemy, and lowers or raises his halberd (戈). Discriminating (know, knowing, knowledge).

k:給.mnemonic: A purse tied with thread (糸), holding an amount made to suit (合) the work done that month, is handed to each worker. Salary (wage, gift, grant).
k:給.hint: Purse tied with thread each month.

k:署.mnemonic: A net (罒) of ink lines that only one someone (者) can make: his name in his own tangled hand at the foot of the page. Signature (govt office, police station).
k:署.hint: A tangle of ink only he makes.

k:幕.mnemonic: A towel (巾) as wide as the stage comes down, and it is dusk (暮) in the theatre: the act is over. Curtain (bunting, act of play).

k:絶.mnemonic: The weaver's favourite color (色) of thread (糸) runs out in the middle of the pattern, and the shop no longer makes it. The line just stops. Discontinue (sever, cut off, interrupt).

k:答.mnemonic: The reply is written on a slip of bamboo (竹) cut to suit (合) the slip the question came on. Put the two together and they match. Solution (answer).

k:仁.mnemonic: A leader (亻) who treats any two (二) people alike, rich or poor, with the very same kindness. Humanity (virtue, benevolence, charity).
k:仁.hint: Same kindness for any two people.

k:僕.mnemonic: Who here has both beauty (美) and humanity (仁)? The young man grins, points a thumb at his own chest, and says that would be him. Me (I, servant, manservant).
k:僕.hint: Thumb pointed at his own chest.

k:倉.mnemonic: A flag (尸) over the dockside building shows whose cargo is inside, and every crate is stacked to suit (合) its neighbour. Godown (warehouse, storehouse, cellar).
